name: HTML5 Webcam/Screen/Mic Recorder for Video Comments and Forms
author: videowhisper

sections.description:
Add browser-based webcam video, microphone audio, screen recording, photo and screenshot capture to WordPress comments and custom forms. Visitors can preview a source, record media, review the result and submit it alongside a comment or form entry.

Key Features

  • Form and Comment Integration: Add recording fields with a shortcode, or show selected capture actions directly in a comment form.
  • Capture Types: Webcam video, microphone audio, screen recording, webcam photos and screenshots.
  • Preview and Review: Display source availability and permission guidance, switch between available cameras or microphones, then review, discard, retry or accept a result.
  • WordPress Attachments: Accepted media is uploaded as a WordPress attachment with available browser media information.
  • Video Share VOD: Optionally process and publish accepted video and screen recordings through Video Share VOD.
  • Custom Workflows: Suitable for comments, paid questions, messages, custom forms and reaction recording. Works with PaidVideochat – Video Services Site.
  • Multiple Items: Configure whether a comment or form can collect multiple captured items.
  • Admin Test Helper: Create, open and remove a standard video-comments-test post with comments enabled from the Test Video Comments settings tab.
  • Community Feed Recordings: Optional BuddyPress and BuddyBoss integration lets members capture video, audio, screen recordings and photos, add an optional caption, and publish a dedicated activity update.

Note: Recordings are saved in formats supported by the user’s browser (e.g., MP4, WebM). Please be aware that some formats may not be compatible with all browsers.

The recorder uses current browser media APIs for video, audio, screen and still-image capture.

Transform your WordPress site by enabling rich, multimedia user interactions with this intuitive and versatile recording plugin.

The existing HTML5 Videochat / Cam Recorder integration remains available for established workflows.

Sample integration: Paid Questions / Messages forms can include recordings in PaidVideochat – Video Services Site plugin.

Use [videowhisper_recorder_inline field="recordings" add_field="1"] for the selected app in WordPress comments, paid-question/message or other custom forms. The bundled browser adapter sends accepted media to a local WordPress REST endpoint, then dispatches a videowhisper-recorder:saved browser event for custom integrations. Enable the optional community-feed integration from Settings > Form Media > Integrations when BuddyPress or BuddyBoss is active; it publishes media with an optional caption as a dedicated activity update. Settings adapt to the selected recorder application.

With the browser recorder selected, Settings > Integrations can show enabled Video, Audio, Screen Capture, Photo and Screenshot controls on comments/forms. Use mode="audio", mode="screen", mode="photo" or mode="screenshot" for one enabled type, modes="video,audio" for a subset, and direct_preview="1" to skip the introductory Continue screen.

The browser recorder adapts its camera presentation to landscape or portrait use, supports available camera and microphone switching, and provides a review step before upload.

Support

Display the selected recorder with [videowhisper_recorder_inline field="recordings" add_field="1" label=""]. Accepted browser captures create a WordPress attachment and dispatch the videowhisper-recorder:saved event for custom form handling. When field is supplied, the integration also maintains the field value for the submitted recording references. Existing HTML5 Videochat / Cam Recorder integrations remain supported.

  • Official Webcam Microphone Screen Recorder Demo
  • Contact VideoWhisper
sections.changelog:
Unreleased

  • Fixed a deprecated PHP warning on the Form Media list when pagination is not needed.
  • Added quick links to enabled integrations from the Form Media list and Integrations settings.
  • Added opt-in BuddyPress/BuddyBoss activity-update media capture.
  • Improved BuddyPress/BuddyBoss feed rendering for attached captures and collapsed the activity composer controls behind an Add Media Capture button.
  • Registered the Form Media settings screen under both the plugin menu and Settings.
  • Grouped recorder actions on one responsive comment action bar and collected accepted items below it.
  • Added the Integration setting to allow multiple comment items; disabled mode replaces the prior item of any type.
  • Made accepted recorder dialogs close automatically and clarified webcam/microphone action labels.

2.3.1

  • Moved bundled assets to recorder, without development source maps.
  • Restored shared Media Library and Video Share VOD settings for the browser and legacy apps.
  • Fixed the bundled browser app production build and added the administrator Video Comments test-post helper.

2.3.0

  • Added the bundled Webcam, Microphone & Screen Recorder as the default for comments and custom form fields.
  • Added local WordPress REST upload, opaque recording references and attachment metadata.
  • Kept HTML5 Videochat selectable with its legacy-only settings.

2.2.9

  • Moved screenshots to SVN assets and updated WordPress.org support metadata.

2.2

  • Support for video comments
  • PHP 8 compatibility
  • Screen recording

2.1

  • Replaced with HTML5 Recorder

1.92.4

  • Integrates Video Share VOD
  • Integrates BuddyPress: allows inserting videos into activity posts

1.92

  • Strobe player
  • Container settings for easy setup on Red5 servers (Wowza recommended)
  • Shortcode updates to work with other filtering plugins

1.55

  • Integrates VideoWhisper Video Recorder 1.55
  • HTML5 playback support (if conversion is possible)

1.45.2

  • Shortcodes for code reliability
  • Support for JwPlayer Plugin https://wordpress.org/extend/plugins/jw-player-plugin-for-wordpress/
  • More settings
  • Fixed plugin folder name

1.45

  • First release
  • Integrates VideoWhisper Video Recorder 1.45
  • Record and embed video when writing post
  • Settings
  • Recordings list to delete recording files (if folder is accessible)
